errors.text_span: The sectors appear to be arranged in a clockwise direction, starting from the top, with the largest sector "Транспорт" (Transport) followed by "Индустрия" (Industry), "Домакинства" (Households), "Услуги" (Services), and the smallest sector "Селско стопанство" (Agriculture).
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the sectors are arranged by size in descending order. The actual visual order of the sectors on the chart, starting from the top and moving clockwise, is: "Индустрия" (28.0%), "Транспорт" (34.6%), "Услуги" (12.6%), "Домакинства" (22.9%), and "Селско стопанство" (1.9%). This is not an arrangement by size. Additionally, the description incorrectly identifies the sector at the top as "Транспорт" (Transport), when it is actually "Индустрия" (Industry).
